newsitem.title: KUWAIT: NIC says Qatar deal part of expansion pla.
newsitem.headline: NIC says Qatar deal part of expansion pla.

text.p: Kuwait's National Industries Co (NIC) said on Saturday its acquisition of 16.3 percent of the Qatar Hot Briquetted Iron Company (CABICO) is part of a plan to expand its industrial assets to $1 billion in 2005.
NIC signed a deal with a group of Qatari and foreign firms on Tuesday under which it would acquire 16.3 percent of CABICO's stake, NIC officials said.

The deal is part of a plan by NIC to increase its industrial assets to $1 billion in the year 2005 from over $300 million through a range of businesses in materials processing, environmental improvement and private development of utilities, they said.
In 1996 NIC, which makes building materials, plastic fittings and detergents and is one of the largest Arab industrial firms, completed a $154 million acquisition of BI Group Plc.
